name: CommandProps
description:
A command palette combines a search input with a list of commands, allowing
a user to filter and run them.

filter.description: Collator options used to match items against the query as the user types.

defaultInputValue.description: The default value of the autocomplete input (uncontrolled).

disableAutoFocusFirst.description:
Whether or not to focus the first item in the collection after a filter is performed. Note this
is only applicable if virtual focus behavior is not turned off via `disableVirtualFocus`.

disableVirtualFocus.description:
Whether the autocomplete should disable virtual focus, instead making the wrapped collection
directly tabbable.

inputValue.description: The value of the autocomplete input (controlled).

onInputChange.description: Handler that is called when the autocomplete input value changes.

slot.description:
A slot name for the component. Slots allow the component to receive props from a parent
component. An explicit `null` value indicates that the local props completely override all
props received from a parent.
